messages:
jess: heads up — canary deploy for inference-api started with ROTATED_KMS_KEY env. rolling 10% now.
deploy-bot: canary 10% healthy=98% latency p95=220ms
mike: seeing increased 500s hitting canary nodes, looks like KMS decryption errors
carla: /logs snippet: ```ERROR: KMSDecryptException AccessDenied for key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-rotated```
sre-oncall: I'm paged. taking lead. @mike @carla, can you link the trigger and the exact times?
mike: correlation: errors start at 14:03:22 UTC right after deploy step that updates ENV ROTATED_KMS_KEY
jess: we rolled the key id to alias/new-key in the canary batch. poss rotation missing IAM permission on inference nodes
sre-oncall: mitigation plan: 1) flip feature flag to route traffic off canary (kill-switch) 2) rollback env on canary to previous key 3) if needed abort rollout
carla: FLIP: `feature-flag set inference-api.canary_enabled false` — done. traffic to canary down to 0% :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: canary traffic: 10% -> 0% (graceful) 
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-542 triggered; severity P1; customer impact: customers on canary saw 5-10% 500 errors, affecting request throughput to smaller customers
sre-oncall: while traffic migrates, mike please attempt manual env revert on one canary pod and test decrypt
mike: `kubectl set env deploy/inference-api-canary ROTATED_KMS_KEY=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/old-key` -> pod restarted. test returns 200s and no KMS errors
sre-oncall: good. carla please coordinate with infra to add decrypt permission for new key principal to instance role; do not re-enable canary until perms confirmed
carla: opened ticket INFRA-1234, added policy change, rolling to canary nodes now. ETA 15m
jess: created postmortem stub and customer comms draft. noting we must improve deploy checklist to validate KMS perms pre-rollout
eng-prod: notifying downstream teams. recommend canary stay off for 1 hour after infra change
sre-oncall: timeline: 14:02 deploy started; 14:03 errors; 14:04 flag flipped; 14:08 manual revert validated; 14:22 infra perms applied; 14:35 canary re-enable + 0%->10% ramp with validation
mike: after perms fixed, canary healthy metrics back to baseline
incident-bot: Incident PD-542 acknowledged by sre-oncall. handoff to postmortem owner @jess
jess: will create RCA and assign actions: enforce KMS permission validation in deploy pipeline, add canary permission smoke test, and add runbook for feature-flag kill-switch. tagging @carla for infra work
sre-oncall: closing slack thread here; will update incident timeline in the incident tracker.
